author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two stacked candidate busts (head + shoulders, 4-unit ink gap), a vertical axis, and two result bars of different length with square ends; follows the reference. The rejected drawing merged heads into the shoulders. The heads are small (r2) because two busts with the exact 8-unit head gap plus an 8-unit gap between rows use the full 40-unit height.
omissions: Heads are r2 rings (read almost solid) - the only radius that fits two busts with the mandated head-to-shoulder gap.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L; bust series at x 13: heads r2 at y 6/30, shoulder half-ellipses rx5 ry4 apex y 16/40; axis x 27 y 4..44 split at bar joins; bars 8 tall at y 8..16 (to x 40) and 30..38 (to x 35) with r2 corners.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'bar-chart-horizontal' axis and bars; bust from the shared human reference user.svg.
